dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're the instructor here, I presume?

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: That's right, I'm the current Head Instructor of the Royal Military Academy, Lukyana Vasilyevna Dragomirova, Officer Third Class.

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: As you can see, my duty is to forge these youngsters into blades to be wielded for our Tsaritsa, to protect our nation.

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: If you're not a student here, please don't stay for too long, or you may interfere with the normal flow of classes.
